getFound.note: Google Business Profile, reviews and replies
getFound.label: Get Found

metering.visit: Appointments scheduled in the period with status completed, checked in or in progress; recall placeholders excluded
metering.enquiry: WhatsApp contacts who first wrote in the period and were not already patients, plus unknown inbound callers (calls of at least minCallSeconds) not already counted from WhatsApp
metering.voiceMinutes: AI voice minutes: inbound AI calls plus AI outbound calls (human dialer excluded)

onboarding.text: One-time setup ₹25,000–50,000, depending on the data we migrate.

capabilities.what: Every enquiry answered, followed up and booked.

items.name: AI Receptionist
items.what: Answers every WhatsApp enquiry in seconds, day or night, answers questions and books appointments.

items.name: Lead Nurture
items.what: Follows up new enquiries who have not visited yet, around the treatment they asked about, until they decide.

items.name: Cold Lead Retry
items.what: One more friendly attempt with enquiries that went quiet after nurture.

items.name: Follow-up on Request
items.what: When someone says "check with me next week" or "after Diwali", AUMY follows up exactly then.

capabilities.what: Every visit confirmed, kept and cared for afterwards.

items.name: Appointment Reminders
items.what: Confirms every booking and reminds patients before the visit, with easy rescheduling.

items.name: No-show Re-book
items.what: Messages patients who missed their appointment and helps them rebook.

items.name: After-Treatment Care & Follow-Up
items.what: Treatment-specific care instructions and check-ins after the visit; anything urgent goes straight to your team.

items.name: Lab Order Follow-Ups
items.what: Tells the patient when their crown, aligners or dentures are back from the lab and books the fitting.

capabilities.what: The next step a treatment needs, before the patient forgets it.

items.name: Care Gaps
items.what: Finds treatment steps that never happened — crown after a root canal, retainer after braces, overdue cleaning — and reaches out.

items.name: Treatment Plan Follow-Up
items.what: Follows up patients who were advised a treatment and are still deciding.

items.name: Treatment Plan Reminders
items.what: Once a plan is accepted, keeps the patient on track until every step is done.

capabilities.what: Patients who drifted away, brought back and kept close.

items.name: Doctor Check-in
items.what: Personal check-ins in your doctor’s voice to patients not seen in a long time, paced at the number you choose.

items.name: Referral Thank-You
items.what: Thanks patients who refer others, so referrals keep coming.

items.name: Birthday Wishes
items.what: A warm, personal birthday message — goodwill only, no offers.

items.name: Festival Greetings
items.what: Wishes your patients on festivals and holidays in your clinic’s name.

capabilities.what: Other patient messages that keep the clinic running smoothly.

items.name: Doctor Unavailable
items.what: When a doctor is suddenly away, tells booked patients at once and offers another doctor or a later slot.

items.name: Intake Form Before the Visit
items.what: Sends the intake form link before the visit, so history is filled in before the patient arrives.

items.name: Review Request
items.what: Asks how the visit went; happy patients get a Google review link, unhappy ones alert you first.

items.name: Educational Content
items.what: Short oral-health tips and videos, like brushing and flossing technique.

items.name: Treatment Upsell
items.what: Suggests a related treatment that suits the patient, such as whitening after cleaning.

capabilities.what: The software your team runs the clinic on. Always included.

items.name: Appointments, patient records & dental charting
items.what: Calendar, doctor schedules, patient workspace, prescriptions, X-rays and invoices.

items.name: Digital registration, intake & consent
items.what: Forms filled and signed on the patient’s phone or the clinic iPad — a paperless front desk.

items.name: AI Charting
items.what: Turns typed or spoken clinical notes into structured records — procedures, diagnoses, prescriptions — with a short visit note.

capabilities.what: Switch on only if you need them.

items.name: AI Voice Agent
items.what: Answers calls your front desk cannot get to, books and reschedules by phone, and calls for reminders.

items.name: Get Found
items.what: Keeps your Google Business Profile active, grows reviews and replies to them for you.

items.name: Meta Ads Management
items.what: We run your Facebook and Instagram ads, and AUMY tells Meta which leads became patients.
